lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web to long lower flange, about 56 deg. The 25/50/75% sections put the label apex 0.02-0.06 mm off the measured outer-skin apex, on the outer skin, not the inner one. Points on the apex with apex-oriented normals run over t -94..124 and the line spans -93.9..123.6, so it covers the full fold. Parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web to upper strip (patch 7), about 50 deg. Sections are 0.01-0.03 mm off the outer apex. The apex run is t -63..90 and the line is -62.9..88.4. The points within 1 mm below t -63 are the web plane next to the relief slot or B3, not this fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web to the large end plate (patch 5), about 50 deg. This is a separate fold from B2: it is offset across the relief slot and not collinear. Sections are 0.00-0.06 mm off the outer apex. The visible fold runs about t -75..-31 and the line -72.4..-29.2, so coverage is about 94%. The ends are off by about 2.5 mm (short at the left, slightly into the slot at the right), which is still within the 80% coverage rule.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Web to the right-end down flange (patch 15), about 90 deg. Sections are 0.01-0.03 mm off the outer apex, which sits 1.68 mm in from the sharp because of the inside radius. The apex run is t 96..124 and the line is 96.3..124.0. The face-on view matches the flange width.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Small holed tab, about 88 deg, bent from the end edge of the upper web step. The rounded fold is clear in all three sections, 0.00-0.03 mm off the outer apex. The tab width is t 3..12 and the line is 3.7..12.2. It is also visible in the long-axis cross-section at s=-102.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Web lower edge at the left end to the short wall (patch 14), about 90 deg. Sections are 0.00-0.02 mm off the outer apex. The apex run is t -107..-85 and the line is -107.9..-85.4. The long-axis cross-sections at s -300..-284 show it as the lower vertex of the web, wall and tab chain.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Short wall to holed tab, about 40 deg, well above the 10 deg threshold. Sections are 0.00-0.01 mm off the outer apex, on the convex upper skin. The apex run is t -13..12 and the line is -11.5..12.1, about 1.5 mm short at one end.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Web left end edge to end flange (patches 12/13), about 90 deg. Sections are 0.00-0.02 mm off the outer apex. The apex run is t -13..14 and the line is -14.0..14.4. The face-on view matches the flange width between the rounded corners.
